sentences.en: Our calculations show that the rocket is off its course.
sentences.zh: 我们的计算表明火箭偏离了航线。

sentences.en: There are a lot of results and a calculation mistakes.
sentences.zh: 有很多结果和计算错误。

sentences.en: I beg to point out that your calculation is wrong.
sentences.zh: 我请求指出你的计算是错的。

senses.zh: 计算，计算(的结果) - 推断；预测，估计 - 盘算，深思熟虑，慎重的计划 - 自私的打算；算计 形容词: calculative
